mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (actor_id, fleet_id, action, target_type, target_id, outcome, detail_code, request_id, operated_at) VALUES (#{actorId}, #{fleetId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{outcome}, #{detailCode}, #{requestId}, #{operatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, actor_id, fleet_id, action, target_type, target_id, outcome, detail_code, request_id, operated_at FROM operation_log ORDER BY operated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
